title: E₆ sphere-packing optimality conjecture
statement: The E₆ root-lattice density is optimal among unit-sphere packings in Euclidean dimension six.

counterexample.description: A positive-definite rational 6×6 Gram matrix whose lattice has minimum squared norm at least four and determinant strictly below 192. This is a unit-sphere lattice packing denser than scaled E₆.
